name: Grimalkin
source:
Uruzuki's familiar. He's kind of like a cat, but the rumor is he's not. Known to disappear in shadows and become giant upon command, he's pretty useful!

[From [url=https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000004727.000001719.html]PR Times[/url]]
